description:
I'm a passionate Software Engineer interested in building innovative, scalable, and impactful solutions.

I'm looking to build a collaborative team of creative, committed, and problem-solving individuals who are passionate about turning ideas into real-world solutions.

Skills I'm looking for: Frontend and Backend Development, Data Science, and UI/UX Design. You don't have to know everything; passion, commitment, teamwork, and willingness to learn matter most. Let's build something impactful.
